name: std::vector<T,Allocator>::~vector
intro:
A destructor. 
Destructs the vector. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the vector.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Start with elements 2 and 3; add an element and inspect the container's allocator.
